intro: Every word this module's exercises use, on one deck of flashcards: 252 cards, 129 of them nouns. The vocabulary of this module is academic and formal register: nominal style, research vocabulary and fixed noun-verb pairs, from the themes Kultur & Medien, Gesellschaft & Ehrenamt, Literatur, Arbeit & Kommunikation formell. Write the German, choose it from four options, or flip the card and rate yourself. A word you miss comes back later in the same run, and stays in your weak words until you get it right three times in a row.
tips[0].title: Learn the noun with its verb
tips[0].text: In formal German many nouns only sound right with one verb: eine Entscheidung treffen, Maßnahmen ergreifen, Kritik üben. When a card is a noun, think of the verb it goes with.
tips[0].check.why: Kritik goes with üben: Kritik an etwas üben is the fixed formal pair.
tips[1].title: Culture verbs with fixed partners
tips[1].text: sich auseinandersetzen mit, die Begeisterung für, die Anspielung auf: the preposition is part of the word and has to be learnt with it.
tips[1].check.why: Begeisterung takes für, like sich begeistern für.
tips[2].title: Some nouns live only in the plural
tips[2].text: die Kosten, die Möbel, die Geschwister have no ordinary singular; das Gepäck has no plural. Use them with the matching verb form.
tips[2].check.why: die Möbel is plural only, so the verb is sind.
remember[0]: Never say a noun without its article, not even in your head.
remember[1]: Miss a word? It comes back in the same run. Three correct answers in a row take it off the weak list.
remember[2]: Verbs and adjectives have no article: type them as they stand, like "prägen".
hook: Kritik üben, eine Entscheidung treffen: formal German pairs its nouns with fixed verbs, so learn the noun, its article and its partner.
